data.cases: random sweeps at scales 65504/30000/1/1e-4/6.1e-5 (262144 components each), extreme magnitude quotient, subnormals, tricky-value grid (6400), make_inputs example (8186), single row
data.expected_signal: componentwise tolerance violations > 0 somewhere in the contract domain
data.explanation: FP16 components are exact in FP32, so all products are exact; only the c*c+d*d sum and the final division round (~2^-24 relative each), far below the 5e-7 relative tolerance. Max possible quotient (~6e23) is finite in FP32.

evidence.summary: Comprehensive adversarial sweep (≈1.6M components across extreme-magnitude randoms, structured cancellation, subnormals, extreme quotients, value grid, N=1) found zero componentwise tolerance violations; worst error was 0.32x the allowed tolerance. The hypothesized FP32 cancellation failure does not occur because products of FP16 values are exact in FP32.

rationale: The kernel converts FP16 components to FP32 and computes real_numerator = a*c+b*d, imag_numerator = b*c-a*d and scale = c*c+d*d in FP32, then divides. Products of large FP16 values (|a*c| > 2^24) round in FP32 with absolute error up to ~hundreds; when the two products in a numerator nearly cancel (|ac| ≈ |bd|) the computed quotient can be off by ~1e-6..1e-5 in absolute terms while the exact target is ~0, whose tolerance is only 1e-7. The contract explicitly permits every finite FP16 combination and requires each component to meet 1e-7 + 5e-7*|target|, so this is a defect if it occurs.

scope_evidence.summary: "EVERY combination of finite FP16 component values is legal" and "abs(actual - target) <= 1e-7 + 5e-7 * abs(target)" ... "Compare EACH output component separately against its mathematical value"
"Any mathematically equivalent algorithm and internal precision are permitted if they meet this requirement."

scope_rationale: The contract's public domain includes every finite FP16 component combination and requires the componentwise tolerance abs(actual-target) <= 1e-7 + 5e-7*abs(target); any internal precision is allowed only if it meets this requirement.
statement: The FP32 intermediate precision in the Triton kernel violates the componentwise tolerance (1e-7 + 5e-7*|target|) on adversarial inputs where the numerator products (a*c + b*d or b*c - a*d) catastrophically cancel while components are large FP16 values.
